integer.certified: status optimal, the decision passes the exact rational check, and the wall time is within the limit plus one second (overruns count as time limit)
integer.incumbent: every method starts cold, without a heuristic decision
integer.method_order: cyclic rotation of the five methods by instance index
integer.purpose: exact robust MCKP: threshold-interval search with each bound and HiGHS fixed-threshold subproblems, direct enumeration with LP pruning, compact MILP
integer.singleton_intervals: both threshold searches bound a single-threshold interval by its fixed-threshold LP, as the LP-family search does

lp_direct.agreement: direct maximum M and each search's final lower bound L satisfy L <= M <= L + 1e-6 max(1, |L|) (scaled), up to 1e-9 rounding
lp_direct.method_order: cyclic rotation of (batched, clique, direct) by repeat + seed
lp_direct.purpose: complete LP-family search: batched and clique-LP interval bounds against solving every fixed-threshold LP with the same LP routine
